title: Triggers: API Gateway, S3, SQS, EventBridge and DynamoDB Streams

videos.script: A function on its own does nothing. Something has to start it, and Lambda lists dozens of services that can. {{shapes}} Underneath there are only three shapes. A caller waits for the answer. A source hands the event over and walks away. Or Lambda reads a queue itself. The shape decides who retries, and where a failed event ends up. {{s3}} This lesson takes one real source for each. A bucket calls a function when a photo arrives. You will see the event S3 sends, and run the handler on it in the emulator. {{sqs}} Then a queue, read in batches. One bad message in ten should not send all ten back. You will write the answer that says which one failed. {{stream}} A stream is stricter. Its records are kept in order, so one bad record can stop everything behind it. You will set the three settings that limit the damage. {{rule}} Last, EventBridge. The publisher names nobody, and a rule picks the targets by pattern. moto matches the pattern, and you will watch which of three orders gets through.
